fullValidation.rule: Publication requires successful completion of every gate; consult the linked run for its recorded result.

endpointModel.caveat: Known identical clocks and modeled delivery delays; not browser rendering, TCP congestion, RTC, QUIC or a live game. Events remain strictly ordered; outbox rejection and throughput tradeoffs are retained.

baseline.caveat: Includes clients and server in one process. Not a VPS, native WebRTC, cellular, or complete game simulation benchmark. Counts encoded application traffic, not IP/TLS/provider-billed bytes.

limits: These controlled localhost observations do not establish cellular, maximum VPS capacity or physical-device performance.
Snapshot age is a synchronized estimate with clock uncertainty and includes browser callback scheduling.
Explicit render submission is not GPU presentation. Application impairment does not model complete QUIC congestion.
Pinned Linux WebKit lacks native WT; its successful fallback must not be presented as Safari/iPhone QUIC proof.
Game deployment and actual public gameplay acceptance are recorded separately. No absolute perfection claim.
